hub_bundle is the content-hashed filename of the Hub's JS bundle, which holds all tab text. If the live filename differs from this one, the Hub has changed and this export is stale. See 'Staleness and refresh' in README.md. It moved from index-77c1ec94.js to index-d251bfe7.js between 2026-08-04 and 2026-08-06, which is what flagged this refresh.

sha256 covers the file exactly as it sits on disk, header comment included. line_count is the number of newline characters, so a file with no trailing newline reports one fewer line than an editor shows.
README.md and manifest.json are local scaffolding, not Hub tabs, and are not tracked here.
